about: Corrections to OpenStreetMap way tags where the street as seen on site (street-level pictures compared by eye, 2026-11) differs from what is mapped. Key: OSM way id; tags: replaced over the mapped ones, null deletes. Read by tools/mapgen/osm.ts for every part of the map build (tools/mapgen/observedroads.ts). Besides the OSM keys (parking:<side>[:orientation|:markings|:width], sidewalk:<side>[:width], kerb[:<side>], cycleway:<side>[:width|:surface:colour|:lane], width) the build reads two of its own: verge:<side>=grass|<width in m> (a grass strip between kerb and pavement) and median:contents=grass|parking|hedge|trees (combinable with ';', on a one-way carriageway of a dual road: what lies between it and the other carriageway, on its left). Facts only. Our own keys too: gutter[:<side>]=no|yes|<width>, lane_markings:edge=yes|no|left|right|both, verge:<side>=paving_stones;trees, parking:<side>:trees=<every n m>|yes, frontage:<side>=hedge|fence|wall|lawn (+ :height), median:contents=…|paving_stones, island:surface=grass|plants|paving_stones|cobblestone|asphalt. Geometry: ways.<id>.shift=[dx,dz] (metres east, south), nodes.<id>=[dx,dz]; areas=[{id,tags,pts:[[x,z],…]}], newWays=[{id,tags,pts,connect}], remove=[way ids] (docs/MAP_DATA.md). Way edits (tools/mapgen/waysplit.ts): split=[{osm,at:[x,z]}] cuts a way, its parts '<id>:<n>' (from 1, in drawing order) take tags in ways and may be removed in remove; merge=[{id,a:[ways],b:[ways],from,to,tags}] makes two one-way carriageways one two-way way over a stretch; points=[{id,at,tags,way?}] puts a tagged node into the nearest road (traffic_calming=table|hump|bump|cushion|choker|chicane, beacon=yes, highway=give_way …). Own keys: mouth:kerb=lowered|raised, markings:give_way=yes|no, markings:zigzag=left|right|both, road_text=<text> (+:position, :backward, :backward:position), sidewalk:<side>:surface|:colour=grey|red|anthracite, traffic_calming:depth.
